import { refusedWith } from "./problemmockhelper";
import { unexported } from "./problemmockhelper";
import { ProblemError, throwProblem } from "../lib/problem";

// Each line marked `want:` must be read with exactly those codes; every other
// line must be read as no Problem at all. A comment saying
// { status: 403, code: "forbidden" } is not one, and neither is the string
const quoted = '{ status: 403, code: "forbidden" }';
const pattern = /"code":\s*"forbidden"/;

const status = { status: 403, code: "forbidden" }; // want: forbidden
const titled = { title: "Forbidden", code: "forbidden" }; // want: forbidden
const detailed = { detail: "no", code: "forbidden" }; // want: forbidden
const withDetails = { details: { a: 1 }, code: "forbidden" }; // want: forbidden
const keyed = { "status": 403, "code": "forbidden" }; // want: forbidden
const cast = { status: 403, code: "forbidden" as const }; // want: forbidden
const either = { status: 403, code: ok ? "forbidden" : "not_found" }; // want: forbidden not_found
const plain = { status: 403, code: `forbidden` }; // want: forbidden
const built = { status: 403, code: `for${bidden}` }; // want: computed

const bodyAndStatus = json({ code: "forbidden" }, 503); // want: forbidden
const viaResponse = new Response(JSON.stringify({ code: "forbidden" }), { status: 403 }); // want: forbidden
const viaMsw = HttpResponse.json({ code: "forbidden" }, { status: 403 }); // want: forbidden
const statusVariable = new Response(JSON.stringify({ code: "forbidden" }), { status }); // want: forbidden
const statusChosen = new Response(JSON.stringify({ code: "forbidden" }), { status: ok ? 200 : 403 }); // want: forbidden
const either2 = new Response(JSON.stringify(ok ? { code: "forbidden" } : { code: "not_found" }), { status: 404 }); // want: forbidden not_found
route.fulfill({ status: 503, body: JSON.stringify({ code: "forbidden" }) }); // want: forbidden
const nested = { status: 403, error: { code: "forbidden" } }; // want: forbidden

const base = { status: 403, title: "Forbidden" };
const spread = { ...base, code: "forbidden" }; // want: forbidden
const spreadIn = { title: "Forbidden", ...(ok ? { code: "forbidden" } : {}) }; // want: forbidden

const thrown = new ProblemError({ code: "forbidden" }); // want: forbidden
throwProblem({ code: "forbidden" }); // want: forbidden

const CODE = "forbidden";
const named = { status: 403, code: CODE }; // want: forbidden

function refusal(code: string) {
  return json({ title: "Refused", code }, 403);
}
refusal("forbidden"); // want: forbidden

const problem = (status: number, code: string, detail: string) =>
  jsonResponse({ status, code, detail }, status);
problem(503, "unavailable", "down"); // want: unavailable

function passesOn(code: string) {
  return refusal(code);
}
passesOn("forbidden"); // want: forbidden

refusedWith("forbidden"); // want: forbidden
unexported("forbidden");

const story = <Story problem={{ status: 403, code: "forbidden" }} />; // want: forbidden
const text = <p>Don't "quote" a {"{ status: 403, code: 'forbidden' }"}</p>;
const generic = <ListSurface<Row> rows={[]} />;

const country = { code: "vn", name: "Vietnam" };
const bare = { code: "vn" };
const succeeded = json({ code: "vn" });
const okStatus = json({ code: "vn" }, 200);
const okResponse = new Response(JSON.stringify({ code: "vn" }), { status: 200 });
const field = { status: 422, code: "validation_error", details: { errors: [{ field: "a", code: "too_long" }] } }; // want: validation_error
const prop = <Create existing={{ id: "1", code: "duplicate_email" }} />;
const type = (x: { code: string; status: number }) => x;
